ja.title: Claudeが見つけた酵素系。その発見は再現できるか
ja.summary: ART酵素系の公開ゲノム2件で反復モチーフを再計算する。探索の分母、949セッションの計数、再発見0/10と固定入力の認識率を区別し、RNAの観測から機能の検証まで残る問いを整理する。
ja.seo_title: Claudeが見つけた酵素系。その発見は再現できるか

en.title: Claude and the ART enzyme system: sequence recognition versus reproducible discovery
en.summary: A known-motif audit of two public phage genomes separates sequence-pattern verification from autonomous discovery. Reported campaign counts, identifier-limited zero recoveries in ten reruns and fixed-input recognition are kept distinct from molecular function.
en.seo_title: Claude and ART: recognition versus discovery
en.seo_description: Two public phage genomes confirm known motifs. Campaign accounting and fixed-input recognition are distinguished from reproducible discovery and function.
